# reference jurisdiction

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:referenceJurisdiction`](gmeow-referenceJurisdiction.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/referenceJurisdiction>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The jurisdiction (country, state, province, or territory) under whose legal framework this cadastral reference is valid. Functional: a single reference has exactly one governing jurisdiction.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CadastralReference`](../classes/gmeow-CadastralReference.md) -> [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:referenceJurisdiction`](gmeow-referenceJurisdiction.md) from [`gmeow:CadastralReference`](../classes/gmeow-CadastralReference.md) to [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single jurisdiction under whose legal framework a cadastral reference is valid; functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid multiple jurisdictions per reference.

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:referenceJurisdiction`](gmeow-referenceJurisdiction.md) (a [`Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md)) per [`CadastralReference`](../classes/gmeow-CadastralReference.md).
